other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test set with test statistics
other_failure_modes.description: Missing values in the test set are imputed using statistics (e.g., mean) calculated from the test set itself, rather than using the statistics learned from the training set. This is a subtle form of data leakage and makes the pipeline unsuitable for online predictions.

summary: The agent implements a basic LightGBM model with a temporal validation split but fails to perform any feature engineering, which is typically crucial for time series prediction. Furthermore, imputation is performed incorrectly, causing validation statistics to leak into the training set and wrongly using test statistics to impute the test set.
